source:
@@U01792@@
I'm dying! Quickly said and quickly done. Why are you standing there howling? Come here. Listen.

@@U01793@@
(They all gather round him.)

@@U01794@@
Listen to me, 格蕾琴— you're young, young but not very clever where it counts, and you've made a real mess of things. Let me tell you something. You're a whore, so you might as well play it to the hilt.

@@U01796@@
My brother! Dear God! What are you saying?

@@U01798@@
Leave God out of this! What's done is done. You began on the sly with one, but there'll be more, count on it, and when you've had a dozen the whole town can come calling. Shame’s birth is a secret thing, her little ears and head are hidden by night in a veil of darkness, and all would like to kill and forget her. But she grows, she grows, and parades around brazenly in broad daylight, and not any prettier. And the uglier she grows, the more she seeks out daylight.
translation:
@@U01792@@
我快死了！说得快，做得也快。你为什么站在那里嚎叫？过来吧。听。

@@U01793@@
（他们都聚集在他周围。）

@@U01794@@
听我说，格蕾琴——你很年轻，很年轻，但在关键的地方却不太聪明，你把事情搞得一团糟。让我告诉你一件事。你是个妓女，所以你最好玩得尽兴。

@@U01796@@
我的兄弟！亲爱的上帝！你在说什么？

@@U01798@@
让上帝远离这一切吧！已经完成的事情已经完成了。一开始你会偷偷地拿一个，但以后还会有更多，相信吧，当你拥有一打的时候，整个镇的人都会来找你。耻辱的诞生是一件秘密的事情，她的小耳朵和脑袋在夜晚隐藏在黑暗的面纱中，所有人都想杀死她并忘记她。但她长大了，长大了，光天化日之下明目张胆地到处游行，一点也不漂亮。她长得越丑，就越渴望阳光。
